To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the addition of 15% of milled millet grains before and after microwave processing to the wheat flour improves the quality of bread in terms of organoleptic characteristics, and the bread has a harmonious taste, aroma, attractive colour, pronounced smell, and porous structure.

adding 5–15 percent whole-milled millet to bread recipes before and after microwave processing improves the organoleptical and physico-chemicall properties of the bread, making it suitable for consumption by all age groups, including children and the elderly.
adding 5–15 % of whole-milled Millet grain to wheat flour improves the quality of bread and can be recommended for use in the food industry.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of whole-milled grain of millet in the production of bread.

the development of the technology of obtaining functional bread with the addition in the amount of from 5 to 15% whole millet grain, which has high organoleptic characteristics and nutritional and biological value.
finding the optimal conditions for using milled millet in bakery products.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the addition of whole-milled cereal to the bread recipe has a positive effect on the organoleptic and physical-chemical characteristics of bread, which is especially noticeable after microwave treatment.
the introduction of 5% whole-milled barley grain after microwave treatment into the bread composition improves its organoleptic characteristics.
adding whole-milled grain millet to wheat flour improves the quality characteristics of the bread.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of whole-milled grain to wheat flour is a promising direction in the development of bakery products.
millet is a cereal with a high content of protein, carbohydrates and vitamins, and its introduction into the composition of wheat bread improves the quality of the product.

the use of whole-milled grain of millet in bakery products can significantly improve their quality, as well as expand the assortment of bakery products, which is especially important for the development of the bakery industry in Ukraine.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the introduction of milled millet in the bread-making industry will allow us to expand the range of products with a new, original taste, aroma, and appearance, which will attract the attention of the consumer.
millet grain is an alternative raw material for the manufacture of bread.
the use of millet grain in bakery products is a promising area in the field of functional foods, which will be in demand in the future.
